circum-sĭlĭo , īre, v. n. salio,
I.to spring, leap, or hop around (rare): (passer) circumsiliens modo huc, modo illuc, * Cat. 3, 9.— Trop., to leap about, surround: morborum omne genus, * Juv. 10, 218.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
